title: ATHSRUEAS Studio
summary: A local studio for writing, showcasing software, and building interactive demos for my personal site.
description:
A personal publishing workspace adapted from open-sitebuilder. It combines a visual canvas with native essay and software-project editors, writes directly to the Astro site, and keeps recovery copies when content changes.

The layout lab below is a small example of the browser-only demos the studio can build. Adjust the controls to explore the relationship between columns, spacing, and available space.

demo.js: const grid=document.querySelector('#grid'); for(const name of ['columns','gap']){document.querySelector('#'+name).addEventListener('input',event=>{const value=event.target.value;document.querySelector('#'+name+'-value').textContent=value+(name==='gap'?' px':'');if(name==='columns')grid.style.gridTemplateColumns=`repeat(${value},minmax(0,1fr))`;else grid.style.gap=value+'px';});}
